items.title: Baker Hughes Awarded Offshore Production Enhancement and Stimulation Services Contract by bp
items.category: ガスタービン・技術サービス
items.excerpt: Baker Hughes received a multi-year bp contract for offshore production enhancement and stimulation services in the UK North Sea. The scope uses its modular StimFORCE stimulation package for well completions and production enhancement, with the company emphasizing reliability, reduced non-productive time and recovery optimization.
items.query: site:bakerhughes.com September 2026 Baker Hughes production enhancement stimulation services bp

items.title: Chromalloy Achieves CMMC Level 2 Certification
items.category: ガスタービン・技術サービス
items.excerpt: Chromalloy says Redspin, an authorized C3PAO, assessed all 110 NIST SP 800-171 requirements across its enterprise IT systems and operating locations for CMMC Level 2. The certification supports handling Controlled Unclassified Information and participation in U.S. defense and government aerospace/MRO programs.
items.query: site:chromalloy.com September 2026 Chromalloy aerospace MRO certification

items.title: Assurance of Modeling and Simulation for Certification Cases
items.excerpt: Quest Global proposes an assurance framework for using modeling and simulation in certification cases, covering input provenance, model assumptions, modeler capability, verification/validation and solver assurance. A vibration case shows simulation informing a test-specification review while the article still treats confirmatory testing as indispensable.
items.query: site:questglobal.com August 2026 modeling simulation certification aerospace

items.title: Integrating Digital Threads and Digital Twins in Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing
items.excerpt: Quest Global describes linking design, manufacturing, delivery and field-support data through digital threads and twins, including PLM/PDM integration, design-stage simulation and predictive maintenance. It reports customer-case improvements including 44% production-efficiency gain and right-first-time rising from 67% to 95%; these are vendor-reported outcomes.
items.query: site:questglobal.com August 2026 digital thread digital twin aerospace defense manufacturing

items.title: GE Aerospace to Acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP), Expanding Mission-Critical Castings Capacity
items.excerpt: GE Aerospace announced an agreement to acquire Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75 billion. CPP manufactures highly engineered airfoil and structural castings using titanium, superalloys and other metals. GE says the combination will expand casting capacity and support current and next-generation engine technologies.
items.query: site:geaerospace.com September 2026 castings manufacturing engine acquisition CPP

items.title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney invests $25 million to expand precision parts manufacturing in Niepołomice, Poland
items.excerpt: Pratt & Whitney announced a $25 million expansion of its Niepołomice, Poland facility, adding more than 120 jobs and capacity for complex tubular assemblies used on GTF, PW800 and F135 engines. The expansion is planned to be operational in 2028 and complements investment in advanced isothermal-forged parts in Rzeszów.
items.query: site:rtx.com Pratt Whitney September 2026 manufacturing engine parts Poland

items.title: CoreWeave Launches Physical AI Field Engineering to Turn Proprietary Data Into Production AI
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: CoreWeave launched Physical AI Field Engineering, building on Monolith AI, to embed domain engineers with customers and develop, validate and deploy models using proprietary test, simulation and sensor data. The engineering-data focus makes the organization worth monitoring for industrial and CAE-oriented AI deployment.

items.title: NTT develops interpretable AI technology for autonomous optimization of thin-film growth
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: NTT reports an interpretable AI system that autonomously optimizes thin-film growth conditions while exposing decision factors to researchers, targeting experimental materials-process development. Its closed-loop combination of physical experimentation, optimization and explainability makes NTT worth monitoring for scientific AI.
